body: IGNORE_SPINE a graphic icon illustration, extremely tight close-up crop showing only the upper face and headwear of a cartoon knight character, filling the entire square frame edge to edge with no margin, no border, no frame, no vignette, no card shape. A dark helmet or hood is pulled low, covering most of the face and one eye, leaving only ONE large simple cartoon eye visible: a plain white circle with a thin black ring iris and one small white highlight dot, no eyelashes, no pupil detail, no anime styling. A tiny round bead-shaped earring hangs near the visible cheek. Thick, bold, uniform-width black outlines trace every single shape. Coloring is flat cel-shaded blocks only -- two or three flat tones per surface (a base tone and one darker shadow block), absolutely no soft gradients, no 3D rendering, no glossy highlights. The ENTIRE image, background included, is recolored in a single flat color duotone photo-filter -- every tone in the image, from the darkest shadow to the brightest highlight, is a shade of the SAME one hue, with no other hues present anywhere. A heavy, uniform, fine-grained analog film grain / static noise texture covers the entire image evenly from edge to edge, like a low-bitrate video screenshot -- not clustered at the corners, not a vignette, spread evenly across every pixel. Flat 2D vector illustration, minimalist app-icon or sticker style, square composition, no text, no logo, no watermark, no distressed paper texture, no torn edges
